name: Grade 10 — Mathematics
subject: mathematics
description: Algebra, trigonometry, coordinate geometry and statistics

questions.question: What are the roots of x² - 5x + 6 = 0?
What is sin(30°)?
questions.explanation: sin(30°) = 1/2. This is a standard trigonometric value to memorise.

questions.question: Find the distance between points (3, 4) and (0, 0).
What is the probability of getting a head when a fair coin is tossed?
questions.explanation: A fair coin has 2 equally likely outcomes (H or T). P(Head) = 1/2.

questions.question: What is the sum of interior angles of a triangle?
questions.explanation: The sum of interior angles of any triangle is always 180°.
